# Dispatch E Windows acceptance

1. A synthetic provider secret survives real current-user DPAPI protection, process/store restart and unchanged AES-GCM payload decoding. Legacy independent-format fixture migrates successfully.
2. Corrupt DPAPI data, simulated cross-user/protector failure and absent key with existing ciphertext preserve files and expose unavailable; do not create plaintext fallback.
3. Native backup chooser grants no arbitrary renderer path/archive access. File replacement, corruption, oversize, expiry and stale expected domain hashes prevent restore. A lost receipt retries the same operation id.
4. Stop an export while the chooser waits: no export/write starts. A completed atomic restore cannot be cancelled retroactively. UI states all-world scope explicitly.
5. Synthetic offline upgrade snapshot verifies by hashes and preserves original data after corruption. An open database file blocks snapshot/installation.
6. Diagnostics contain no synthetic key, chat, private path or world source. Missing metric samples stay absent; actual RSS is labelled main-process only.
7. Build both NSIS and win-unpacked from a clean commit. Verify required resources, source archive and manifest hashes. Do not launch the installer or a visible test window on the user's host.
8. Remaining clean VM gate: first install, app launch without development tools, close/reopen, upgrade/failed upgrade, manual domain restore and uninstall retaining data. The VM and any interactive actions require an authorized isolated environment; otherwise mark unverified.
